Hi [user_name], I think your question could be phrased more clearly, but... If you have an analog input (other than what the 'Wizard' selects) and want to split it into different ranges, my example might help. The program divides a non-linear voltage signal from a temperature sensor into four distinct ranges. For three ranges, amplifiers convert the values into linear outputs, and a multiplexer chooses the correct equation for the analog output. The final range, in my example, triggers an alarm instead of a translation. Best regards, [user_name]
Thanks for the help. My question was regarding having four analog inputs, selecting the highest value, and using it to modulate a 0-10V valve motor.
